episodes.name: Beware the Old Soldier
episodes.overview: Joe, Kyle, and the QRF team embark on a timely extraction after a high-ranking government official is kidnapped by a cartel.

episodes.name: I Love My Country
episodes.overview: After a new Lioness is identified, Joe and her team travel to Iraq to close the asset.

episodes.name: Along Came a Spider
episodes.overview: Kaitlyn works to drum up support for their plan. Meanwhile, Lioness training begins for Captain Josie Carrillo.

episodes.name: Five Hundred Children
episodes.overview: Joe and Kyle make contact with a potential new source of intel. A newly expanded team conducts a hit with unanticipated results.

episodes.name: Shatter the Moon
episodes.overview: The warehouse discovery rattles the team. Joe is torn between two urgent missions.
Events come to a head at the Carrillo estate faster than expected. Josie makes her move.

episodes.name: The Devil Has Aces
episodes.overview: Despite Joe's weakened state, the team is forced back to Iraq to make a point.

episodes.name: The Compass Points Home
episodes.overview: Operation Sky Hawk is a go as Kaitlyn and Westfield pressure Pablo to side with them.

name: Season 2
overview: In Season 2, as the CIA's fight against terror moves closer to home, Joe, Kaitlyn, and Byron enlist a new Lioness operative to infiltrate a previously unknown threat. With pressure mounting from all sides, Joe is forced to confront the profound personal sacrifices she has made as the leader of the Lioness program.
